notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.There is at least one additional creature on the battlefield.
description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Grim Poppet's ability by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, targeting any other creature.
Holding priority, activate Necrotic Ooze using Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat from step 2.
